original_prompt: Create one photorealistic wardrobe catalog product image, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, truthful fabric texture, portrait 2:3. Extract/reconstruct ONLY this detachable accessory from the 整图 outfit, exclude all garments and all other objects: A dark brown felt fedora with medium brim and darker grosgrain hatband.
